name: Apshait
body:
Apshait Swarm CR 2

These deadly beetles move in an undulating swarm of red and black, with oversized mandibles clicking and chittering.

XP 600
N Large swarm of Diminutive vermin (swarm)
Init +5; Senses blindsight 10 ft.; Perception +2; Aura stench (5 ft., DC 13)

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 12, flat-footed 24 (+3 Dex)
hp 30 (6d8)
Fort +3, Ref +6, Will +1
Defensive Abilities swarm traits; Immune mind-affecting effects, weapon damage

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., burrow 5 ft. (earth or sand only), climb 20 ft., fly 10 ft. (poor)
Melee swarm (2d6 plus distraction and paralysis)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks distraction (DC 13), paralysis (1 round, DC 13)

STATISTICS

Str 2, Dex 17, Con 10, Int -, Wis 10, Cha 3
Base Atk +2; CMB -; CMD -Feats Improved Initiative
Skills Climb +11, Fly +5, Perception +2; Racial Modifier +8 Climb

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Flesh Gnawing (Ex)

Creatures with flesh and blood and a natural armor bonus of less than +8 take an additional 1d6 points of damage from an apshait swarm’s attack, or 2d6 if they are prone or paralyzed.

Paralyzing Venom (Ex)

Living creatures damaged by the apshait swarm’s attack can be paralyzed by the beetles’ toxic venom. This is a poison effect. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Stench (Ex)

Apshait swarms exude a foul stench of carrion and embalming fluid. Creatures beginning their turn within 5 feet of the swarm are sickened for 1d4 rounds (DC 13 Fortitude negates).

This stench affects creatures before saves are rolled for the swarm’s distraction or paralyzing venom. A creature succeeding on its save is immune to the stench for 1 minute.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate forests
Organization solitary, pair, colony (3-6)
Treasure none

These beetles exclusively live off the corpses of the dead.

They are harmless individually and only pose a threat as a swarm, erupting from the remains of the ancient embalmed dead when those mortal remains are disturbed.
